decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PC-11-003/01HT, PC-11/003/02HT and Design and Access Statement received 09/03/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the mobile classroom shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 3 - The mobile classroom hereby approved shall be removed from the site in full within 36 months of the date of this permission unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of a single storey mobile classroom unit to the north of the site.
